summary: Join our team as a Senior Software Developer to architect, design, and deliver scalable mobile and web applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver seamless user experiences and robust functionality.
responsibilities: Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient backend systems using C# .NET
Lead the transition from monolithic systems to microservices and cloud-native architectures
Collaborate with frontend teams to integrate backend services smoothly
Optimize application performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and ensure security and data protection protocols are implemented thoroughly
Participate in code reviews, establish best practices, and mentor junior and mid-level developers
Manage and configure web servers and deployment pipelines
Drive technical decisions and strategic planning to align software development with business goals
required_skills: 5+ years of professional experience in backend software development with strong proficiency in C# .NET
Solid experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and Flutter
Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, design patterns, and database systems (SQL and NoSQL)
Practical experience with cloud platforms like Azure and AWS, and implementing CI/CD pipelines
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of React and Flutter as a strong advantage
Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, or similar)
education_level: Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical field
benefits: Opportunities to work with a global team
Opportunities to work on and lead innovative projects
Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave
Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform
Access to a variety of employee resource groups
